patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality product photography is used as hero backgrounds and section dividers, often with text overlays, creating an immersive visual experience.
A sophisticated pairing of a large, bold, serif display font for hero headlines and key messages with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
A warm, inviting accent orange/terracotta is used for CTAs and highlight elements, contrasting with a largely monochromatic palette of black, white, and various shades of grey.
Background images in hero and full-width sections exhibit a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth.
Product listings are presented in a clean grid with prominent imagery and clear pricing, often featuring a discount badge for promotional items.

technique_notes: A sticky header navigation remains visible at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site navigation.

Large hero and full-width section background images are implemented with a subtle parallax scrolling effect, where the background moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, enhancing visual depth and engagement, likely using a library like locomotive-scroll.
Content sections are revealed with a gentle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth and engaging scroll experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold serif headings (up to ~4-5x body text) are used for impact, complemented by clean, well-spaced sans-serif body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are applied to buttons, product cards, and image containers, softening the overall aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, while product grids maintain a comfortable density.

standout: The site stands out with its sophisticated blend of high-end product photography, a warm and inviting accent color, and elegant typography. The subtle parallax scrolling on large background images creates a premium, immersive feel that elevates the product presentation beyond a typical e-commerce grid.
